work_completed: Studied before implementing (owner's order on PR #1040): Avalonia InputMethodManager/AndroidInputMethod source, Gboard/LatinIME/FlorisBoard behaviour, Swift Playgrounds shortcut bar, community IME/accessibility issues; consolidated in apps/lunet2d/docs/research/teclado-nativo-ide-2026-11-25.md.

LunetKeyboard: one surface with Teclas (Gboard-like, PT-BR accents on long press, Shift/caps, repeat, glide cursor and glide delete, indent-keeping Enter), Atalhos (former CodeKeyBar plus undo/redo/line edges) and Métodos (generated API + game members via Roslyn, Recentes/Mais usados, overloads, context-aware insertion).

The system IME is disabled only on the code editor while the Lunet keyboard is shown; tabs never take focus; hardware keyboard and screen reader fall back to the system; 🌐 switches to the system keyboard.
Emulator hook and ci-android-shell.sh now type with the Lunet keyboard on Android 13 and check that the system IME is off.
